fields.Name: Skip ICF - Course Completion Rate by Quarter
fields.Description: Completion rate (Completed / all enrollments) by enrollment quarter from MoreCheese: Course Enrollments, 2023-2025. Ported from "Monthly Course Completion Rates".

InputDefinition.userMessage: Show me our course completion rate by enrollment quarter for 2023 through 2025 as a line chart. Completion rate = completed enrollments divided by all enrollments that quarter. When I click a quarter, show me the courses that had enrollments that quarter with their completion counts. [NO CHAT]

judgeValidationCriteria: Response includes a line chart of completion rate by quarter for 2023-2025
Completion rate uses MoreCheese: Course Enrollments Status (Completed vs Dropped/InProgress) and is shown as a percentage
Rates are realistic for the data: roughly 60-85% per quarter, about 72% overall
Quarters with no enrollments are omitted or shown as gaps rather than as 0%
Clicking a quarter shows the courses with enrollment and completion counts for that quarter
Course rows can open the underlying course record
